representation_fit.evidence: Brief demands understand × temporal-sequence over change_set objects with readable causality; the product renders exactly that: a horizontal time-scaled SVG timeline (source/app.js:133-135 timeToX maps time→x), 24 change nodes in five type lanes, phase bands as the medium-hierarchy grouping (source/app.js:175-188), and 19 causal links drawn strictly left→right with the on-canvas grammar hint '连线方向 = 时间方向：诱因永远在左，后果永远在右' (source/index.html:23). Both screenshots show the P0 incident c16 with its full cause chain highlighted (screenshots/1280x860.png, 1440x900.png).

primary_task_salience.evidence: The timeline canvas is the dominant surface (grid column minmax(0,1fr) vs 400px aside, source/styles.css:49) and the app boots pre-selected on the pivotal change c16 with cursor pinned to its moment (source/app.js:156), so cause→effect reading is the first thing on screen: detail panel shows '诱因 · 为什么发生' with c14 and the highlighted orange chain in both screenshots. State snapshot ('游标时刻各组件的状态 = 此前全部变更的折叠', source/index.html:47) directly serves the 'state evolving over time' job.

time_to_understand.evidence: Orientation aids are excellent: title+subtitle (source/index.html:12-13), type legend with counts, causal-direction hint (index.html:23), footer stats '24 个变更集 · 8 个组件 · 19 条因果链 · 5 个阶段' plus integrity badge (both screenshots). Deduction: projected text is sub-minimum at 1280 — check type.min_projected_size = fail (measurement-summary.json:16); the viewBox 1180-wide SVG scales down in the ~856px column (source/app.js:133, source/styles.css:105), making 10.5px node/lane labels (styles.css:111,113) project to roughly 8px in screenshots/1280x860.png, which slows parsing of the canvas.

navigation_cost.evidence: Zero-step reach: the primary object (change_set) is fully laid out on the initial screen; any node is one click, nodes are keyboard-reachable (tabindex=0, role=button, Enter handler — source/app.js:241,265), ←/→ step chronologically, C/E jump to cause/effect, Esc clears (source/app.js:500-508; footer kbd hints index.html:58), and ?sel/?cursor/?filter deep links reproduce state (source/app.js:552-565).

context_loss.evidence: All primary actions update in place with no routes/modals: select() re-renders canvas+detail+snapshot together and aligns the cursor to the selected change (source/app.js:440-446); cause/effect jump links (data-jump, app.js:395-397, 434-436) and clickable edges (app.js:232) keep the same screen; component filter dims non-matching nodes/edges rather than removing them (app.js:291-298), so spatial/temporal context is preserved.

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent surfaces map one-to-one onto the brief's facets: timeline (temporal sequence), phase bands (medium hierarchy), snapshot card = fold of changes ≤ t (state evolution, source/app.js:107-111), detail card = field-level before→after (change semantics, app.js:371-382), 8 component chips + play + draggable cursor as the only controls (index.html:25-31, styles.css:72-101). No decorative or redundant chrome; density is high but each element earns its place.

accessibility.evidence: Genuine effort exists (aria-labels on sections and SVG role=img — index.html:20,33-34,40,44; focusable nodes with :focus ring — app.js:241, styles.css:120), but 3 of 3 measurable a11y checks fail: a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size (measurement-summary.json:13-15). Corroborated in source: #8a93a3 secondary text on white ≈3:1 (styles.css:8; used for hints/footers styles.css:69,107), chips ~20px tall with 11.5px text (styles.css:78-87), 10px jump chips (.fb, styles.css:211-214) below target-size minimums; no visible focus styling for .chip/.btn/.link/.fb.

frontend_rework.evidence: 5 of 7 checks fail with 1 warning (measurement-summary.json:3-7): layout.responsive_collision fail is visible in screenshots/1280x860.png where the narrow P4 band's label '峰值与修复' (app.js:180-186 fallback path) collides with the adjacent green band near 6月, absent at 1440x900; type.min_projected_size fail visible as ~8px projected node labels at 1280 (styles.css:111 + viewBox scaling app.js:133); plus the three a11y failures. Mitigating: layout.overflow and text.truncation pass, target_invalid=false, and no functional/rendering errors (boot READY path app.js:615-618).

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '时间结构与变更语义一致' is engineered, enforced, and surfaced: runtime integrity validation rejects any link whose cause is not strictly earlier (source/app.js:53-57), footer renders '完整性校验：因果方向与时间顺序一致 ✓' visible in both screenshots (app.js:536); snapshot fold and detail before/after share one fold function (app.js:107-122, mc2 comment lines 4-5) with a ?selftest=1 harness asserting forward_only_links and state@t semantics (app.js:568-606); data itself is causally ordered (source/data.js:62-254, e.g. c02 cause c01 line 75).

defects_observed: layout.responsive_collision fail: at 1280x860 the P4 phase-band label '峰值与修复' overlaps the adjacent green band near 6月 (app.js:180-186; screenshot 1280x860), clean at 1440x900
type.min_projected_size fail: 10.5px SVG labels project to ~8px at 1280 width due to viewBox downscaling (styles.css:111,113; app.js:133) — visibly tiny node labels in screenshot 1280x860
a11y.contrast fail: #8a93a3 gray secondary text on white throughout (styles.css:8,69,107,145)
a11y.target_size fail: filter chips ~20px tall (styles.css:78-87) and 10px .fb jump chips (styles.css:211-214)
a11y.focus_order fail (check id a11y.focus_order, measurement-summary.json:14); clickable edges and lane ticks (app.js:232,328) have no keyboard path
At 1280x860 the detail panel's effect list clips mid-row (c20 row cut at panel bottom) — scrollable per styles.css:135 but the fold boundary is not signaled
scores.overall_note: This is a high-fit, seed-aware implementation of the brief's understand × temporal-sequence job: a time-scaled change timeline whose causal links are provably forward-in-time (runtime integrity check surfaced in the footer), a state-snapshot fold sharing one function with the detail panel's before/after (source/app.js:107-122), and the primary object reachable and explorable with zero navigation (click, keyboard, deep links). The initial screen leads with the pivotal P0 incident and its highlighted cause chain, making the primary task dominant. The weaknesses are presentation-hardening rather than conception: 5 of 7 receipt checks fail (measurement-summary.json), concretely a phase-label collision at 1280x860, sub-minimum projected text from viewBox downscaling, and failing contrast/target-size/focus-order checks despite real aria and keyboard effort in the source. Model-judged legibility of the initial screen is therefore slightly reduced at the smaller viewport; task completion time, retrieval accuracy, and human preference remain unobservable in this blind pilot, and no human-preference claim is implied.
